wording: description: "German social insurance contributions for 2026, written for the self-employed and voluntary members. Covers voluntary statutory health insurance (minimum base EUR 1,318.33, ceiling EUR 5,812.50 a month, 14.0% or 14.6% plus the fund's additional rate, average 2.9%), long-term care at 3.6% with the childless surcharge and child reductions, compulsory pension insurance for the self-employed groups in § 2 SGB VI (teachers, carers, midwives, craftspeople, one-client workers) with the 18.6% rate, standard, start-phase and income-based bases, exemptions, voluntary pension contributions, the Künstlersozialkasse and the 4.9% artists' levy, accident and unemployment insurance on application, the status procedure, due dates, late surcharges and the income tax deduction, plus a short employee summary. Trigger on: Krankenkasse freiwillig, Mindestbeitrag, KSK, Künstlersozialabgabe, Rentenversicherungspflicht Selbständige, Pflegeversicherung Kinderlosenzuschlag, Statusfeststellung. Out of scope: the payroll run (de-payroll), benefits in kind and managing directors (de-payroll-benefits), income tax (de-self-employed-income-tax, de-einkommensteuer-freelancer)."

wording: German social insurance for calendar year 2026: health and long-term care (charged on the same base), pension, unemployment, and accident insurance paid by the business. The insurance rules apply to everyone employed or self-employed in Germany, and the rules that do not need work apply to everyone resident here ([§ 3 SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__3.html)).

wording: 1. **Settle the status.** Work under instructions and inside the client's organisation points to employment ([§ 7(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__7.html)). If unclear, use the status procedure below.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 2. **Employees:** insured by law in all four branches. Test the JAEG (health and care only) and the Minijob limit, then hand the payroll to `de-payroll`.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 3. **Self-employed health:** a main-occupation self-employed person is not compulsorily insured as an employee (§ 5(5) SGB V) and must hold statutory voluntary or private cover ([§ 193(3) VVG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/vvg_2008/__193.html)). Give the fund the latest tax notice, or at the start the expected income.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 4. **Health amount:** all income, lifted to the minimum base and cut at the ceiling, times the reduced rate (general rate if sick pay was elected) plus the fund's own additional rate. Care on the same base at the rate for the member's children and age.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 5. **Pension:** test the § 2 SGB VI list. If a group applies and the work is more than marginal, check registration under § 190a SGB VI and choose the contribution; check the exemptions. Otherwise decide on voluntary contributions or insurance on application.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 6. **Artists and publicists:** test the KSVG conditions, register with the KSK, report next year's expected income by 1 December.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 7. **Accident and unemployment:** notify the accident insurer within one week of starting; decide on unemployment insurance on application within three months.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 8. **Artists' levy:** if the business pays self-employed artists or publicists, test the levy duty and report the fees by 31 March of the next year.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 9. **Pay and check.** The fund's or insurer's notice is the amount. Never rebuild a year's total from rates: add up the debits and check them against the notices.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: 10. **Income tax:** deduct the contributions within the caps of [§ 10 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__10.html). They are private, not business expenses.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: Pension registration follows the group-specific route and clock in § 190a SGB VI, described below. Unemployment insurance on application has a three-month work-start window, and the status procedure a one-month window for the stated protection. For ordinary self-employed pension exemptions under § 6(4) SGB VI, the three-month period runs from when the exemption conditions are met.

wording: Employees working for pay are insured by law in health ([§ 5(1) no. 1 SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__5.html)), care ([§ 20(1) SGB XI](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_11/__20.html)), pension ([§ 1 SGB VI](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_6/__1.html)) and unemployment ([§ 25(1) SGB III](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_3/__25.html)). They are also covered by accident insurance, which the employer pays alone ([§ 150(1) SGB VII](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_7/__150.html)). The employer pays the total to the employee's health fund ([§ 28h SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28h.html)).

wording: - **The JAEG (health and care only):** an employee whose regular yearly pay exceeds EUR 77,400 is free of compulsory health insurance ([§ 6(1) no. 1 SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__6.html)). For someone already insured, cover ends at the end of the year the limit is exceeded, but only if the pay also exceeds next year's limit (§ 6(4)). The special JAEG of EUR 69,750 applies only to those privately insured on 31 December 2002 for that reason. Such an employee may stay voluntarily or go private; either way the employer pays a subsidy ([§ 257 SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__257.html)).
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **Minijob and transition band:** pay up to EUR 603 a month is a Minijob ([§ 8(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__8.html)). Above that, up to EUR 2,000 a month, the employee's share is reduced ([§ 20(2) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__20.html)). Both are in `de-payroll`.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **Job plus business:** if self-employment is the main occupation, the job does not bring compulsory health insurance (§ 5(5) SGB V), but pension and unemployment insurance of the job continue. If the job is the main occupation, the employee is insured through it and the freelance income carries no health or care contribution: the contribution is on pay. The exception is an employee who also draws a statutory pension or a pension-like payment (Versorgungsbezüge): then the freelance income counts too, if it and any pension-like payments together exceed 1/20 of the monthly reference amount (EUR 197.75 in 2026) ([§ 226(1) no. 4 and (2) SGB V](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_5/__226.html)). Employing someone above the Minijob level raises the presumption that self-employment is the main occupation; the fund decides case by case.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: **Case: employee above the JAEG.** Hired 1 January 2026 at EUR 7,000 a month (EUR 84,000 a year), childless, age 40. Pay exceeds EUR 77,400, so the employee is free of compulsory health insurance and may stay as a voluntary member or go private, with the employer's subsidy. Pension and unemployment continue at 9.3% and 1.3% on the full EUR 7,000: EUR 651.00 and EUR 91.00 from the employee. Payroll steps: `de-payroll`.

wording: - **Who decides.** The parties to a contract can ask the Deutsche Rentenversicherung Bund, in writing or electronically, whether it is employment or self-employment. This is not possible once a health fund or another insurer has already started its own procedure on the same contract ([§ 7a(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__7a.html)). The fund must apply where the employer's report shows that the worker is the employer's spouse, partner or descendant, or a managing shareholder of a GmbH. The decision rests on an overall assessment of all circumstances. Other insurers are bound by it.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **The test.** Signs of employment are work under instructions and being part of the client's organisation ([§ 7(1) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__7.html)). Working for one client only is not by itself employment, but it can trigger compulsory pension insurance as a one-client self-employed person (group 9 above). Keep the two risks apart.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **Before the work starts.** On application the decision can be made before the work begins (§ 7a(4a)). Changes in the first month must be reported at once. A client can also ask for an opinion that covers other contracts of the same kind (§ 7a(4b)). These options, the third-party rule of § 7a(2) sentences 2 and 3, and the right to a joint hearing expire at the end of 30 June 2027 (§ 7a(7)). Check the law for any contract running past that date.
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **The one-month window.** If the application is made within one month of the work starting and employment is found, insurance starts only on the day the decision is announced. Two conditions apply: the worker consents, and for the time in between the worker had cover against illness and for old age comparable to the statutory schemes. The total contribution then falls due only when the decision can no longer be challenged (§ 7a(5)).
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **Appeals.** An objection or court action against the decision has suspensive effect (§ 7a(6)).
disposition: Exact original current unit, native coordinates rebound

wording: - **If employment is found later**, and neither the individual one-month protection nor the qualifying group-opinion protection applies, ordinary contribution liability reaches back to the start of the work. Late-payment surcharges can follow, subject to the actual § 24 rules: where a contribution notice operates retrospectively, no surcharge is levied to the extent the debtor credibly shows lack of knowledge of the payment duty without fault ([§ 24(1), (2) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__24.html)). Refer before the client signs or at once when it comes up.

wording:
**Example 2: yoga teacher in the first year, low income, one child.** Starts teaching on 1 March 2026, profit about EUR 1,000 a month, no insured staff, one child aged 10, voluntary health member without sick pay. Health: the base is lifted to the minimum of EUR 1,318.33, so health EUR 222.80 (check) and care at 3.6% EUR 47.46. Pension: a teacher with no insured staff is on the § 2 SGB VI list and EUR 1,000 is above the EUR 603 Minijob limit, so the work is not marginal. Register within three months: the nominal end of May is Sunday 31 May 2026, so the ordinary deadline is Monday 1 June 2026 under [§ 26(3) SGB X](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_10/__26.html). This assumes no authority notice expressly fixing the day under that provision or authority-set appointment under § 26(5). In the start phase (to the end of 2029) the base is half the reference amount: EUR 1,977.50 x 18.6% = EUR 367.82 a month, or EUR 735.63 on application. Total EUR 638.08 a month on EUR 1,000 of profit, which is why the minimum bases matter.

```oa-check

inputs:
  profit_month: 1000
  reference_month: 3955
  ceiling_month: 5812.50
  minijob: 603
  extra_rate: 2.9
steps:
  - min_base: reference_month / 3
  - base: clamp(profit_month, min_base, ceiling_month)
  - health: round(base * (14.0 + extra_rate) / 100, 2)
  - care: round(base * 3.6 / 100, 2)
  - above_marginal: max(0, profit_month - minijob)
  - pension: round(reference_month / 2 * 18.6 / 100, 2)
  - total: health + care + pension
expected:
  base: 1318.33
  health: 222.80
  care: 47.46
  above_marginal: 397
  pension: 367.82
  total: 638.08
```

section: R72–77 actual ordinary condition / source-read statement
wording: - **Group-opinion protection.** If a DRV opinion under § 7a(4b) assumed self-employment and a later status or insurance proceeding finds employment for the same contractual relationship, § 7a(4c) starts compulsory insurance only on notification of that decision if the worker had the comparable illness and old-age cover required by § 7a(5) sentence 1 no. 2. The contract must have been concluded within two years after receipt of the opinion. Same relationships require the same type and circumstances of work and uniform contractual agreements under paragraph 4b. The individual route's one-month application and consent requirements do not apply to this alternative. Under current § 7a(7), paragraph 4c expires at the end of 30 June 2027.
